title: Meta / Facebook / Instagram Ads - Campaign Manager
description:
Meta ads campaign manager

 Part-time contractor | Remote | Set hourly rate

 

MUST READ IN FULL TO APPLY

About us

Venture to Bloom is a content studio based in Maryland, USA. We run pop-up content creation days for entrepreneurs and small business owners in the DC/Maryland/Virginia area, and we work with consultants, coaches, and business teams to produce video and photo content that drives revenue. We're in growth mode and ready to start running paid ads that actually convert.



The role

We need an experienced Meta ads specialist to first help us diagnose and resolve an issue with our Meta business account setup, then build and manage campaigns from the ground up. This is a set hourly rate engagement with consistent weekly hours and potential for long-term partnership as we scale.

You'll be our go-to person for all things Meta. That means you're not just running ads; you're thinking through the full funnel and making sure every dollar we spend has a job to do.



What you'll be doing

Account audit and setup (first priority):

Diagnosing why our Meta business account isn't properly configured for Venture to Bloom and resolving it. This may involve verifying the business, troubleshooting Business Manager or Ad Account permissions, and determining whether Meta support contact is needed. We need this sorted before anything else can move forward.



Ongoing campaign management:

Installing and verifying the Meta Pixel on our website and landing pages. Building custom audiences from our
 list, website visitors, and Instagram followers. Creating lookalike audiences based on our best converters. Setting up retargeting sequences for people who've visited our registration pages or engaged with our content. Choosing the right campaign objectives for each goal (awareness, lead gen, event registrations, etc.). Building and managing A/B tests for creative, copy, and targeting. Providing clear weekly reporting with plain-language takeaways, not just numbers.



Requirements

Must have:

Proven experience running Meta ads campaigns with demonstrable results (not just setup experience)

 Deep understanding of Meta Business Manager, Ad Account structure, and business verification

 Pixel installation and event tracking setup (including custom conversions)

 Custom audience and lookalike audience strategy

 Retargeting and multi-stage funnel logic

 Experience selecting and justifying campaign objectives based on business goals

 Strong written communication in English

 Ability to explain what's happening and why in plain language, not jargon



Nice to have:

Experience running ads for service businesses, events, or registration-based offerings

 Familiarity with MailerLite or other
 platforms for list-based audience uploads

 Landing page conversion analysis (identifying what's working and what isn't)

 Experience troubleshooting Meta business account issues or working with Meta support



Project details

Hours: ~5 hours per week (consistent, ongoing)

 Rate: Set hourly rate; include your rate in your application

 Work hours: Flexible with US Eastern time overlap preferred

 Timeline: Immediate start; first priority is account audit



How to apply

Video (preferred): Record a short video, 3 minutes max, answering these three questions:

Walk me through a Meta ads campaign you managed from setup to results. What was the goal, what audiences did you build, and what did performance look like?

If you discovered a client's Meta business account wasn't properly configured and ads couldn't run, what are the first three things you'd check and how would you approach fixing it?

Describe a retargeting sequence you've built. What triggered entry into the sequence and what was the goal at each stage?



Upload your video to Google Drive or Loom and include the link in your application. Keep it simple. I want to see how you think, not a production.



OR



: 



Include:

A brief overview of your Meta ads experience and types of businesses you've worked with

 2-3 results you've driven (even rough numbers are fine; just be honest)

 Your hourly rate

 A note on whether you've ever resolved a Meta business account setup issue and what that looked like

Please start your message with the word BLOOM so I know you read this in full.

Looking forward to hearing from you.





Kristen Noelle

 Co-founder, Venture to Bloom

title: Product Researcher — Trend & Demand Specialist (German Market)
description:
About us

We run a portfolio of e-commerce webshops powered by Google Ads. Each store carries thousands of products, and we add hundreds of new ones every single week. Our edge is speed and selection: we find products people are already searching for on Google, list them fast, and let demand do the rest.



We sell primarily into the German market (DACH region), so a deep, instinctive feel for what German consumers want — and what they'll want next — is the heart of this role.



The role

We're looking for an experienced Product Researcher who can consistently spot products that will trend in the coming months before they peak — and validate that real Google search demand exists behind them. You'll feed our pipeline with a steady, high-quality stream of products that have proven search volume and rising interest in Germany.



This is a research-and-judgment role, not a data-entry role. We need someone whose product picks reliably convert into search traffic and sales.



What you'll do

- Research and identify products with rising or established Google search demand in the German/DACH market.

- Forecast upcoming trends and seasonal demand 1–6 months ahead, and flag products before they saturate.

- Validate demand using tools like Google Keyword Planner, Google Trends, 
, and search volume / keyword data.

- Deliver a weekly shortlist of vetted products (target: hundreds per week across stores) with search volume, seasonality, and competition notes.

- Track competitors, marketplaces (
, Otto, Kaufland, 
), and German social/shopping trends.

- Work closely with our Google Ads and listing teams so winning products get to market fast.



What you bring

- Proven track record in e-commerce product research, trend spotting, or dropshipping/retail sourcing — with results you can point to.

- Deep knowledge of the German market: consumer behaviour, seasonality, language nuances, and what sells in DACH.

- Hands-on skill with Google Keyword Planner, Google Trends, and search-volume tools; comfortable reading keyword and demand data.

- An eye for timing — you understand the difference between a fad, a trend, and an evergreen.

- High output without sacrificing quality; you can work at the pace of "hundreds of products a week."

- Self-directed, data-driven, and comfortable in a fast-moving remote team.



Nice to have

- Experience with Google Ads / Shopping campaigns.

- Familiarity with Shopify or similar platforms.

- Knowledge of German marketplace ecosystems and import/sourcing channels.



How to apply

Send us:

- A short note on your product-research experience and the German market.

- 3 products you believe will trend in DACH over the next 3 months — with the Google search data that backs your pick.

Your availability and rate/salary expectation.



The 3-product test is the part we read first. Show us how you think.

title: Hiring Video Editor(s) for Fast-Growing DTC Health Brand
description:
We are hiring video editor(s) for a fast-growing DTC health brand.



This is for someone who can create clean, high-retention, performance-focused video ads across short-form, UGC-style ads, Reels/TikTok content, VSL-style creatives, landing page videos, and other ecommerce creative formats.



Experienced ecommerce/direct-response editors are highly preferred, but if you are a killer editor with strong taste, speed, and hunger, you should still apply.



We can train the ecommerce/direct-response side if you already have strong editing fundamentals.



What's in it for you:

- Competitive pay based on skill, experience, and output.

- Consistent long-term remote work.

- We accept applicants worldwide.

- Full-time Monday-Friday roles available.

- Weekend coverage roles also available.

- Clear direction, references, examples, and briefs, especially in the beginning.

- Zero micromanagement if the work is high-quality and delivered on time.

- Work with a fast-moving DTC team.

- Opportunity to learn direct-response ecommerce creative.

- Strong performers can grow into higher-paid roles like Senior Editor, Lead Editor, Creative Strategist, UGC Manager, or Creative Lead.



This is not a dead-end editing role. The best editor on the team can grow into a Lead Editor role and eventually help manage other editors. More ownership means more opportunity.



What you'll work on:

- Short-form ads for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Meta, and other paid/social platforms.

- UGC-style video ads.

- VSL-style creatives.

- Product-focused videos.

- Hook variations and cutdowns.

- AI-assisted assets, B-roll, animations, graphics, and visual enhancements.

- Ecommerce ad creatives built around pacing, clarity, retention, and storytelling.



What we're looking for:

- Strong video editing skills.

- Strong sense of pacing, retention, captions, visual rhythm, and storytelling.

- You understand TikTok, Reels, Shorts, UGC, and modern social content.

- You can follow direction closely and match the style/vibe of provided references.

- You can work fast without making sloppy mistakes.

- You have good English comprehension and understand the nuance/vibe of scripts.

- You are comfortable using AI tools or willing to learn them fast.

- You are reliable, responsive, and can hit deadlines.

- You are coachable and hungry to improve.



Big bonus points:

- You have edited ecommerce, DTC, health, or performance-marketing videos before.

- You understand direct-response creative.

- You have worked with 7-9 figure brands before.

- You have edited ads that performed well.

- You can explain why a hook, cut, caption, or pacing choice worked.

- You have experience with VSLs, YouTube editing, creator content, or high-retention long-form editing.

- You want to grow into a Lead Editor, Creative Strategist, UGC Manager, or Creative Lead role.



Important:

We do not care about flashy transitions just for the sake of looking fancy.



We care about edits that make people stop scrolling, keep watching, understand the message, trust the product, and take action.



Async screening:

You will write a short breakdown in this form. Bonus points if you also include a voice-note link. Double bonus points if you include a short video walkthrough link.

Fill out the form below.

Apply here:





Include your best work, any ecommerce/direct-response/ad examples if you have them, a short written breakdown of why an edit/ad worked, optional voice/video breakdown links, what types of videos you are strongest at, your tools/software, your availability, and why you are the best person for this role.

title: Client Care Specialist (Dog Lovers, Neutral Accent, Not a Call Center, 9-5 ET)
description:
Are you a dog lover? If yes, this might be the job for you. You'll be working with US customers whose dogs take our herbal supplements, and helping those customers feel cared for, every single message and every single call.



This is a long-term role. If you're great, we want you with us for years, not months. We're hiring carefully because we want to grow with the right person.



One thing before you read any further: the schedule. This job runs 9:00am to 5:00pm US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday. In the Philippines, that's 9:00pm to 5:00am. You'd be working through the night, every weeknight, for as long as you're with us. Night work fits some lives and not others, so be honest with yourself before you apply. And when you do apply, include one line in your
 confirming you understand this is overnight work.



Customer service experience is a plus, not a requirement. We'd rather hire a kind, hungry learner with zero call experience than an experienced agent who runs a script. If your English is clear and neutral and you truly love helping people and dogs, we'll teach you the rest.



We're a small pet supplement company. Our customers are devoted dog parents. Their dogs are all ages, some healthy, some dealing with health issues, and they reach out to us by
, text, and phone for help. We have a strong in-house knowledge base, and we'll train you on it thoroughly before you ever speak with a customer.



This is not a call center job



If your training is to apologize warmly and move on to the next call, this role will frustrate you. We never measure call times. We measure whether the customer got real help. Being sweet on the phone is the baseline here. The job is getting the customer a real answer.



We're a small, personable business where each customer gets dedicated, white-glove care. You'll have time to actually listen, and to remember a customer's dog's name from her last call. Every
 and every call gets treated like it matters.



Before you take calls alone, we'll train you for weeks on our products and our head herbalist's teaching, and you'll pass a product knowledge check in your first 30 days. When a dog mom asks how other customers get a picky senior dog to take her herbs, we expect an answer from that training. When you don't know, the answer is "I'll find out and call you back today." Then you find out, and you call back. Part of the job is knowing the line: ordering and product questions you handle yourself, deeper health questions get booked into a consult with our herbalist.



You won't be thrown to the wolves. While you're learning, you can pass any hard call to our head herbalist, then listen to the recording afterward to hear how she handled it. We train this deeply because we want you here for years.



What you'll do



- Read and reply to customer service
s

- Reply to customer text messages

- Help customers place orders, track shipments, and resolve order issues

- Set up appointments with our head herbalist for customers who want a deeper conversation about their dog

- Study our knowledge base and keep learning. The more you know, the more you can help.

- Answer phone calls when they come in. Some days are busier than others, but whenever the phone rings, that's your first priority.



Who you are



- Your English is clear with a neutral accent. Have past US customers ever been surprised to find out you weren't based in the US? If yes, please tell us about it in your application. Most of our customers are older American women (ages 40-65). They need to understand you the first time, every time.

- Warm and patient on the phone. You sound like someone who could comfort a worried grandma.

- A genuine dog lover. You'll be talking about dogs all day, every day: their names, their ages, their conditions, their quirks.

- Hungry to learn. We'll hand you real training on herbal pet care, and we want someone who actually wants that knowledge and will use it to help people.

- Kind during hard conversations. Sometimes a customer will tell you her dog was just diagnosed with something serious, or has just passed away. We don't expect you to have medical answers. We want you to be kind, slow down, listen, and let her know you understand.

- Reliable. You show up on time, you follow up, you finish what you start, you don't drop the ball.

- Comfortable with technology. You don't need to know our specific tools. We'll train you on those. If you already know any customer service, e-commerce, or admin tools, list them in your application.



Requirements



- Customer service experience helps but is optional. Clear, neutral English is required.

- Reliable home internet with at least 25 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, and ping under 50ms, on a wired Ethernet connection (not WiFi alone).

- A quiet home office. No background noise on calls: no roosters, no traffic, no kids, no neighbors. Backup power or a hotspot in case of outages is a strong plus.

- Quality USB headset with a noise-cancelling microphone

- Modern computer (Windows or Mac, less than 5 years old)

- Available 9:00am to 5:00pm US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday. That's 9:00pm to 5:00am Philippines time. Please only apply if you can genuinely commit to that overnight schedule, long-term.

- ID Proof verified on your OnlineJobs.ph profile. We only review applications from ID-verified accounts.



Nice to have



- You've worked for a small US-based e-commerce brand answering US customers, and those customers never realized you weren't based in the US. This is the experience we value most.

- Familiarity with any customer service or e-commerce tools (Richpanel, helpdesks, e-comm platforms,
 tools). List anything you've used.

- Other work skills that could help a small company: bookkeeping, admin, writing, social media, scheduling, anything you do well.



Schedule and pay



- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Paid twice monthly

- Long-term role. We're hiring carefully because we want to grow with the right person.



How to apply (please read carefully, incomplete applications will not be reviewed)



In your
, please include all 5 items below. We sort applications by who followed every instruction, not by who applied first.



1. At the very top of your
, write the word "Buddy" in bold. (This is so we know you read all the way to the end of this post.)



2. Record a 1 to 3 minute video covering the four prompts below, and get it to us any way you want: attach the file, paste a YouTube unlisted link, Google Drive, Dropbox, WeTransfer, anything that works.



3. Attach a screenshot of a current speedtest.net result showing your download speed, upload speed, and ping. In the
, also tell us what internet plan you have at home and whether you're on a wired Ethernet connection or WiFi.



4. List any customer service, e-commerce, admin, or office software you have used (for example: Richpanel, Gorgias, Zendesk, Help Scout, Shopify, WooCommerce, Klaviyo, QuickBooks, Google Workspace, anything you actually know). If you've never used any, write "none yet." That's an acceptable answer.



5. List one or more previous employers, teachers, clients, or anyone you've worked for who can speak to your work and character. Customer service references are best if you have them. One is fine if that's all you have.



Video prompts (1 to 3 minutes total, single take, no editing)



Cover all four, in any order. No script. Just talk to us like you'd talk to a customer.



1. Introduce yourself. Your first name, where you live in the Philippines, and one thing about you that's not on your resume.



2. Tell us about any experience helping people. Customer service if you have it, but teaching, retail, nursing, caring for family, anything where someone needed you and you showed up. If you can, tell us about one specific person you helped and what you did for them.



3. Tell us about a dog you've loved. Yours, a family dog, a neighbor's dog, any dog that mattered to you. What was their name, and what do you remember about them?



4. What else can you do? Customer service is the main job, but extra skills are gold to a small team like ours. Bookkeeping, admin, writing, social media, scheduling, anything you do well. If helping customers is your only area, just say so. That's a fine answer.



Tips:



- Record in a quiet room. Audio clarity matters more than video quality.

- Use your phone or webcam. We want to hear the real you.

- 1 minute minimum, 3 minutes maximum. Going under or over is a soft red flag. It tells us how you'd manage time on a real call.



If your application is missing any of items 1 to 5, we will not review it. We're being strict because we're hiring carefully, and because the right person deserves a fair, fast review.



After we watch your video and read your application, we'll reach out if we like you. At that point we'll ask you to obtain an NBI Clearance, and we'll reimburse the fee.

title: TikTok Video Making & Content Coordination Assistant
description:
Job Description: TikTok Video Making & Content Coordination Assistant



We are looking for a reliable and creative person to help us organize TikTok product videos and coordinate local video creators.



This role is suitable for someone who enjoys TikTok, understands trending videos, and can help manage product samples and content creation.



Main Responsibilities



1. Product Sample Coordination



You will receive product samples from us and help organize them for video shooting.



You will need to:



Manage the product samples properly



Keep track of which sample is used for which video



Coordinate with peers or local creators to make product videos



Make sure the samples are returned, reused, or passed to the next creator when needed



Update us on the video progress regularly



2. Find Peers or Local Creators to Make Videos



You will help find suitable people around you who can make simple TikTok-style product videos.



They do not need to be professional influencers, but they should be comfortable filming short videos and showing the product clearly.



Monthly target:



40 TikTok product videos per month



This means around 10 videos per week.



3. TikTok Video Research



You will research trending TikTok videos related to our product or similar products.



Each month, you need to prepare a list of video references.



For each video reference, you should explain why it is useful, such as:



Good opening hook



Good product demonstration



Good selling point



Good editing style



Good storytelling idea



Good chance to become viral



4. Script Writing



Based on the trending video research, you will help turn the ideas into simple video scripts.



Each script should include:



Video opening hook



Main product selling point



How the product should be shown



Suggested video angle



Simple caption idea



Call-to-action, such as “Check this out” or “Try this product”



5. Monthly Content Target



Every month, you will help complete:



40 product videos



Trending video research list



Simple scripts for the videos



Sample tracking record



Progress update report



Requirements



We are looking for someone who is:



Responsible and organized



Active on TikTok



Able to find and communicate with peers or creators



Comfortable coordinating product samples



Creative and willing to research trending videos



Able to write simple video ideas and scripts



Good at updating progress clearly



Work Style



This is not a heavy office job. The main goal is to help us organize samples, find suitable people to make videos, and make sure the TikTok content is completed every month.



You do not need to be a professional video editor, but you should understand what type of TikTok videos look natural, interesting, and easy to watch.



How to Apply



Please send us:



Your name



Your location



Your TikTok or social media experience, if any



Whether you have friends or peers who can help make videos



Any sample video you made before, if available

title: Technical Layout Designer - Marketing
description:
Technical Layout Designer (Catalogues, Datasheets & Manuals | PDF Rebuild ? Ongoing Maintenance | Remote, Part-Time)



We are looking for a detail-focused Technical Layout Designer to create product catalogues/brochures, and to recreate existing product catalogues, datasheets, and manuals from PDF and Word files into fully editable templates. The role also includes ongoing updates and maintenance.



You will be using Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, CorelDRAW, Canva, Affinity Publisher, or similar layout/design software. (Software is flexible — see below.)



This is a long-term, part-time remote role with a heavier workload during the initial rebuild phase, followed by 1–2 hours per week of ongoing maintenance work.



Role Overview



You will be responsible for rebuilding existing technical documents from PDF format into structured, editable templates.



This includes:



Product catalogues

Technical datasheets

Instruction manuals



The initial phase will involve recreating existing documents from PDF/Word files into editable templates, while simultaneously using these templates to produce targeted, sales-focused brochures for specific applications (for example, a spray booth product catalogue).



This means you will be building the underlying template system as part of real, practical brochure and catalogue production, ensuring the structure works for actual sales materials from the outset.



Once this foundation is established, the role transitions into ongoing maintenance work of approximately 1–2 hours per week, consisting of updates, revisions, and small additions as required.



This role is ideal for someone experienced in structured, detail-heavy documentation work where accuracy and consistency are critical.



Key Responsibilities



Initial phase (higher workload):

Recreate catalogues, datasheets, and manuals from PDF/Word files into editable templates

Build consistent, reusable layout systems across all document types

Ensure high accuracy in layout reproduction (spacing, typography, alignment, structure)

Convert technical product data into clean, structured formats

Standardise formatting across multiple document types



Ongoing phase (1–2 hours per week):

Update catalogues, datasheets, and manuals as product information changes

Add new products or technical updates into existing templates

Maintain consistency across all documentation versions

Produce print-ready and digital PDF outputs



Requirements

Experience recreating or rebuilding structured documents from PDF or print

Strong attention to detail (especially technical, numerical, and formatting accuracy)

Ability to follow and replicate existing layouts precisely

Strong understanding of layout systems, grids, and document structure

Comfortable working with structured data (e.g. Excel or similar)

Ability to work independently and maintain consistency across multiple document types



Software

Software is flexible — we are not concerned with specific tools, as long as you can deliver accurate, professional, print and
-ready documentation.



Common tools for this type of work include:

Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, CorelDRAW, Canva, Affinity Publisher, or similar layout/design software.



Nice to Have

Experience with technical, industrial, engineering, or manufacturing documentation

Experience in production design, pre-press, or technical publishing

Familiarity with datasheets or instruction/manual formatting standards

Ability to improve structure, consistency, and workflow efficiency

Experience working with large multi-page document sets



Work Arrangement

Part-time, flexible hours

Higher workload during initial rebuild phase

Then 1–2 hours per week ongoing maintenance

Long-term role for the right person



Please include your expected hourly rate (USD) in your application.



We are open to negotiation depending on experience and quality of work.



Important Note



This role is primarily focused on accurate reconstruction of existing technical documents from PDF, including supplier brochures being converted into company-branded catalogues. The priority is precision, consistency, and reliable template building across catalogues, datasheets, and manuals.



In some cases, you will also be required to create targeted, industry-specific catalogues from existing materials. For example, developing a spray booth catalogue by adapting an existing catalogue template and selecting relevant products for that application. This involves structuring and presenting existing product data in a clear, sales-focused format while maintaining consistency with our branding and documentation standards.



To Apply Please Include

Examples of catalogue, datasheet, or manual layout work (especially PDF reconstruction work)

Your expected hourly rate (USD)

Brief description of your experience with structured technical documentation

Availability during the initial higher-workload phase (hours per week)



Please include the word TECHNICAL REBUILD in your application so we know you have read the full description.

title: Xero Cleanup - Prepare File for BAS & Tax Return
description:

Type: One-day fixed-scope project

Start: Immediately - you must be available within 24 hours and complete the work in one working day

About us

We're a Sydney-based AI and data company preparing for an investment round. Our Xero file is mostly cleaned up - we need an experienced bookkeeper to finish the job and get it ready for our Australian accountant to prepare BAS and tax returns.

The project

The end deliverable: a clean, reconciled Xero file plus a handover summary that our Australian registered tax agent can pick up and run with - no rework, no back-and-forth.



Recode ~1,200 remaining transactions - entered via cash coding, need correct categorisation consistent with the coding already applied to the rest of the file

GST coding accuracy - every transaction coded correctly for GST (GST on expenses, GST-free, BAS excluded etc.) so BAS figures are reliable

Reconcile invoices - mark off paid sales invoices against payments received, confirm outstanding receivables are accurate

BAS & tax-ready handover - end-of-day summary for our accountant: confirmation accounts are reconciled to date, GST report run and sense-checked, plus a list of any items you couldn't confidently code or that need the accountant's judgement (with transaction references)



You are NOT lodging anything - BAS and tax returns will be prepared and lodged by our Australian registered tax agent. Your job is to make their job easy.

Requirements



Available NOW - free for a full working day within the next 24 hours

3+ years Xero experience with Australian clients - GST/BAS coding experience is essential and non-negotiable

Has prepared files for handover to Australian accountants/tax agents before

Strong written English - all communication in writing

Fast AND accurate - this file is going to our accountant and then in front of investors



Payment

Fixed price for the day - quote in your application. Paid promptly on completion.

How to apply

Start your application with "SPRINT" and your earliest start time (with timezone). Then: (1) your fixed price for ~1,200 transactions plus invoice reconciliation and handover summary, (2) describe your experience preparing Australian client files for BAS/tax - name the GST tax rates you'd typically use in Xero (this is a screening question).

title: Inside Sales Agent / Appointment Setter — US Real Estate SaaS
description:
Hi,



I'm hiring sharp, confident phone people to join Paperless Pipeline, a US software company that 1,800+ real estate brokerages run their transactions on. We just launched an AI feature that's an easy sell, and I need someone who can get brokers on the phone and book them onto a quick demo with our team.



This isn't a robo-dialing gig where you read a wall of text. You're the first voice these brokers hear, and you set the tone. If you've got great spoken English, thick skin, and you actually like the phone — keep reading.



How this works: I'm bringing on two people for a paid 2-week trial. At the end of the two weeks, whoever performs best stays on with the company for the full 90-day program. Both trial weeks are paid — this is a real shot to prove yourself, not free work.



-> What you'll do



- Make outbound calls to US real estate brokers and offices (B2B lists — not random consumers)

- Open with a simple hook, handle the usual objections, and book 15-minute calls onto our specialist's calendar

- For brokers who won't book a call, get permission to text them a 60-second demo video — then follow up

- Send the follow-up texts, confirmations, and reminders (templates and a full script are provided)

- Log every call outcome cleanly in our dialer/CRM (JustCall) so we can track what's working

- Settle into a daily rhythm of dials, conversations, and booked appointments — we'll set clear targets together



->  You're a great fit if you have



- Near-native spoken English — clear, warm, and easy to follow on a US phone line. This is the #1 thing.

- Real outbound cold-calling or appointment-setting experience (US accounts a big plus)

- The resilience to hear "no" all day and stay upbeat on the very next dial

- Comfort with a dialer, CRM, and texting tools — JustCall experience is a bonus, not a requirement

- A quiet space, reliable wired internet, a good headset, and a backup power/internet plan

- Availability for US business hours — which means a night shift here in the Philippines



-> Schedule & setup



- Full-time, ~40 hours/week, aligned to US time zones

- Work from home — you provide the quiet environment, headset, and stable connection

- I'd love to have the right person calling within a week



->Pay



- Weekly

- The first two weeks are a paid trial for two candidates. The top performer continues for the full 90-day program — with real room to grow into a lead role as we build out the team.



-> How to apply (read carefully — this part is the test)



I want people who follow instructions and can sell themselves, so:



1. Start your application with the word "PIPELINE" so I know you actually read this post.

2. Attach a "60-second voice recording" — introduce yourself, then pretend you're cold-calling a busy real estate broker for the first time. Don't over-script it; I want to hear your natural phone voice.

3. In a few sentences, tell me about your most relevant cold-calling experience and the results you got.



Applications without a voice recording won't be reviewed. Looking forward to hearing you.

title: Amazon FBA Used Book Sourcing - Remote Requisitions Contractor
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION



A US-based company is seeking Remote Requisition Contractors based in the Philippines to source, analyze, and, when authorized, purchase used books for resale through Amazon FBA.



This is not a general VA role and not a training opportunity. This is a specialized buying and analysis engagement requiring strong attention to detail, accurate Keepa interpretation, sound purchasing judgement, and the ability to follow detailed sourcing criteria.



Contractors will help identify used books available on the Amazon marketplace that may be profitably resold through Amazon FBA. Standard purchase criteria are based on projected ROI, projected profit, and expected turnover.





CONTRACT STRUCTURE



This is an independent contractor engagement, not an employee position. Contractor is responsible for managing their own work methods, tools, hardware, internet access, taxes, and time.



The selection process is multi-stage:

- Application

- Written evaluation covering sourcing concepts, theory, and Keepa interpretation

- Onboarding

- Paid trial period

- Paid sourcing evaluation period

- Ongoing contractor engagement with potential bonus eligibility





RESPONSIBILITIES



- Source used books from the Amazon marketplace

- Interpret Keepa charts to estimate demand, price behavior, offer-count trends, and sales likelihood

- Determine whether a book meets assigned ROI, profit, and turnover objectives

- Use sourcing and analysis tools such as Keepa, BookMine, BooksRun Counterfeit Book Checker, SellerAmp, and Google Sheets

- Check current inventory before making sourcing decisions

- Log sourcing and purchase details accurately in Google Sheets

- Follow assigned sourcing objectives, spending limits, and purchase authority limits

- Maintain accurate time tracking through Jibble

- Communicate clearly through WhatsApp when needed





REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Strong English reading and writing ability

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to interpret Keepa data and/or demonstrated ability to learn advanced sourcing analysis independently

- Comfortable using Google Sheets

- Reliable high-speed internet

- Computer suitable for sourcing work

- Willingness to use Jibble for time tracking

- Willingness to communicate through WhatsApp

- Willingness to submit invoices in USD and receive payment through Wise

- Valid government-issued photo ID and clearance





PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Prior experience sourcing used books for resale on Amazon

- Prior experience using Keepa Product Finder or Keepa Deals

- Prior experience with SellerAmp, BookMine, FlipMine, Zen Arbitrage, Tactical Arbitrage, or similar sourcing tools

- Understanding of Amazon FBA, used book pricing, sales rank, offer count, buy box behavior, and seasonal book demand

- Experience working in performance-based sourcing or online arbitrage roles





TOOLS AND ACCESS



- Contractors are required to use their own Keepa Premium subscription. (Subscription reimbursement is available to eligible contractors.)

- After the trial stage, contract work will take place within the company’s secure remote workspace, where relevant tools for the services are accessible.





COMPENSATION



This two-part compensation model is performance-oriented. It is designed for contractors who want to be rewarded for strong results, not only for time worked. The hourly service rate provides a base, but the larger earning opportunity is intended to come through performance-based discretionary bonuses after the conclusion of the evaluation period. Bonus potential is based on measurable sourcing results, including profitability, ROI, accuracy, productivity, and sell-through performance.



- This contract includes a base hourly service rate of $3 USD for approved billable service hours.

- Eligible contractors can qualify for performance-based discretionary bonuses that allow strong performers to substantially increase their total compensation through consistent, profitable sourcing results.

- A monthly Keepa Premium reimbursement is available to eligible contractors.

- A monthly internet allowance is available to eligible contractors.





WHO SHOULD APPLY



Apply if you are analytical, careful, self-directed, and serious about becoming highly effective at profitable Amazon used book sourcing.



Do not apply if you are looking for basic VA work, general admin work, or a role where the company provides all training from scratch. Contractors are expected to take responsibility for maintaining and improving the skills needed to provide high-quality sourcing services.





HOW TO APPLY



Complete the application form at the following URL:



     



Applications submitted outside the linked form may not be reviewed.

title: Phone Support Executive Assistant/Leasing Agent (WFH)
description:

If you take pride in ownership, genuinely enjoy helping people, and want to become an indispensable part of a growing business, keep reading.



WHO YOU ARE



-You are warm, friendly, and confident on the phone.

-You know how to make people feel comfortable within the first few moments of a conversation.

-You enjoy talking with people and helping them move forward.

-You are reliable, proactive, and take responsibility without needing constant supervision.

-You don't sound robotic, scripted, or transactional, and you usually avoid filler words such as "um."

-You understand that being the first voice someone hears can directly impact a company's success.



AVAILABILITY EXPECTATIONS



-Monday-Friday availability during business hours (U.S. Pacific Time)

-Primary phone monitoring coverage between 6:00 AM and 4:00 PM Monday-Friday (U.S. Pacific Time Zone)

-Ability to answer calls whenever reasonably available during committed working periods

-Additional responsiveness outside primary coverage hours is part of the ownership mindset required for this role



Success in this role is measured by reliability, responsiveness, caller experience, and ownership, not by sitting at a computer for a specific number of hours (and actually it's perfectly reasonable for some things like phone monitoring to be handled via your own mobile phone outside of primary availability hours).



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE (NON-NEGOTIABLE)



-Work-from-home experience

-Night shift experience

-At least 2 years with the same employer

-Executive Assistant, Customer Service, Receptionist, Sales, Hospitality, or BPO experience

-Significant phone-based experience

-Excellent spoken English with a clear and professional speaking voice (using little to no filler words)

-Enjoy using Technology and regularly check your phone

-Prior Property Management experience is not required. We are more interested in strong communication, relationship-building, and phone skills. Our successful teammate came from a sales background.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



• You dislike talking to people

• You prefer scripted conversations

• You need constant supervision

• You are looking for a role that turns into management or a different path. (We are a small company, which means you will already be handling a wide variety of responsibilities across the business.)

• You want a clock-in/clock-out environment



ABOUT US



We are a small (5 members) U.S.-based Property Management company that values loyalty, ownership, and long-term relationships. None of us clock in or out. We view the company's success as our success and don't mind checking in frequently to make sure things are running smoothly.



We believe great team members should be appreciated, recognized, and rewarded.



Our goal is to find someone who thrives with an ownership mindset, wants stability, and desires a long-term home with our family-like company.



COMPENSATION



• Work From Home, Independent Contractor Position

• Full-Time Opportunity

• $800-1000 USD/month + bonuses paid for each property leased (up to $1000 USD additional per quarter)

• Long-term permanent position



If you genuinely enjoy talking with people, taking ownership, enjoy the feeling of being truly valued and making a difference, plus want a long term stable position, we'd love to hear from you.

This role is responsible for leading the finance function of a multi-entity Australian manufacturing and distribution business. You will own month-end close, financial controls, labour costing, WIP reporting, inventory valuation, and cash flow forecasting. You will directly manage two finance tea
mbers and report to the Chief Financial Officer.

1.  Odoo  —  Minimum 3 years in a manufacturing, inventory, or job-costing environment

mbers

Have you managed or directed finance tea
mbers? Yes

Have you built and maintained a 13-week cash flow forecast? Yes

Have you owned month-end close end-to-end without supervision? Yes

Have you worked with Australian entities (GST, BAS, PAYG)? Yes

title: Personal Assistant (in-person / requires travel)
description:
My name is Scott Watkins and I am the owner of a small software development company.  And while we are based in the United States, most of our workforce is in the Philippines.



Actually, our company was one of the first to use the OnlineJobs.ph platform, and John (owner of OnlineJobs) was the one who actually sold us on using the platform.  Today, our small company hires all our staff solely from OnlineJobs.Ph



Here is a brief interview from OnlineJobs showcasing our company: 

==================================



JOB DESRIPTION



So, my wife (Filipina) and I regularly travel to the Philippines to visit her family and collaborate with our VAs/Staff.



We will be arriving in the Philippines this coming late August, and will stay through the first three weeks of September.



I am looking to hire someone who can assist me in researching and planning my itinerary before we arrive (so will technically be my VA before arriving).  They will then meet us upon arrival and will act as my Personal Assistant for the duration of our stay.  Then after we leave, they will follow-up with closing out and finishing any unfinished business left there.



The job will pay an hourly rate based on the number of hours available and worked prior to our arrival .. then will pay a flat rate for the duration of our stay there, followed by an indeterminate amount after we leave based on the work required.



For the most part, while there, the PA will go wherever I go and spend everyday with me.  They will be given time each day for themselves of-course, but will need to be flexible depending on circumstances.  We will be bringing our children, so there will also be some days dedicated to spending time with the family (e.g. Enchanted Kingdom, etc). There will be some days that my wife and I may plan to leave the kids behind and visit certain places as well (e.g. Floating Restaurant in Bohol, etc).  Other times, my wife may wish to go off into the province and visit her relatives (which I definitely do not like doing), so I may d
 to travel by myself to exotic locations around the Philippines, play golf, or just hit up the local malls.  Due to the time difference, I also tend to be a night owl there, and enjoy hitting up clubs/bars/KTVs for some nightly entertainment.



There are too many things to list out, but regardless of where we go and what I do, the PA's job will be to always make sure to be by my side, ensure that I make it safely to whatever destination we go, ensure I have a fun and enjoyable time, and ensure I always return home safely.  This may include running small errands (e.g. getting food/medicine) and occasionally traveling by themselves (e.g. meeting a venue owner to finalize details). But 95% of the time they will be at my side.



There are other things that may be involved (e.g. lodging arrangements and travel accommodations) that will also be discussed in the interview.



But I will cover all expenses for everything; including food, accommodations, travel, and personal expenses.  Including also the salary, which will be discussed and d
 based on skills, experience, and meeting requirements.



Previous experience is not necessary. The main things that matter the most are:

- Understand/Speak English for long periods of time

- Honesty and Loyalty to me

- Willing to go where I want to go, do what I want to do, and ensure I enjoy myself going/doing it

- A consistently positive attitude and eager to please

- An adventurous spirit and willing to go places and do things never done before

- Being flexible and adaptable as things change (as they always do in the Philippines)

- Willing to put in the work and effort to ensure we have a great and smooth vacation



People who are naturally open and conversational will also have a great advantage (e.g. Westerners love to socialize)



All are welcome to apply no matter the location, gender, age, religion, or marital status.  I have hired them all in previous trips.  However, in my previous experience, Younger PAs tend to be more adventurous, Filipinas tend to speak better English, and married individuals tend to be more 'intuitive' with my and my family needs. Additionally, my wife is from Davao, so Bisaya/Cebuano will give you an advantage with her, though not required for me. - But I am open to considering any and all who wish to apply.



If you think you might enjoy traveling the country, accompanying one of the world's greatest bosses, and visiting some of the nicest places the Philippines has to offer, all at my expense ... then I invite you to click on the link and fill out our short application form here: 







You may also
 me at 
 - be sure to include your OnlineJobs profile link, FB, and WhatsApp.



Though filling out the online application will get better response times.



I look forward to hearing from you. 



//Scott Watkins

title: Marketing Coordinator — Technical & AI Production (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
Marketing Coordinator — Technical & AI Production (Remote, Full-Time)

Salary Range: PHP 25,000 – 40,000/month (based on experience)

Hours: Full-time, Monday–Friday. 9 AM - 6 PM (GMT+8)



About Inquivix

Inquivix is a Seoul-based digital marketing agency. We help international companies enter the Korean market through Naver SEO, Kakao advertising, paid media, social media, and web development.



We are a small, fully remote, AI-forward agency. AI is not a nice-to-have here — it is how we work. We use AI across every function: content production, reporting, campaign analysis, process automation, and client delivery. If you think in systems, build workflows, and use AI tools to solve real business problems — not just generate text — this role is for you.



The Role

This is a marketing execution role for someone with a technical mindset. You do not need to be a developer (though dev background is welcome). You need to be someone who thinks about how to make processes faster, more consistent, and more scalable — using AI tools and structured thinking.



You will produce marketing deliverables (content, ads, reports, campaign materials) for our clients, with a focus on finding and implementing better ways to do things using AI.



What you will do:

- Produce client deliverables using AI tools: blog posts, ad copy, campaign materials, reports, content briefs, influencer guidelines

- Identify opportunities to improve production workflows using AI — faster content, better reporting, more consistent output

- Build and maintain AI-assisted production workflows: prompts, templates, review checklists, automation sequences

- Work with campaign data: pulling CSVs, processing data through AI tools, producing formatted outputs

- Propose automation ideas to your PM with documented reasoning: what process, what tool, what risk, what review step

- Maintain quality standards — AI output is never final. You review, verify, and refine everything before submission.





Requirements:

- Strong AI tool proficiency — you use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar tools daily for real production work, not experimentation

- Systems thinking — you see a manual process and immediately think about how to make it faster, more reliable, or more consistent

- Comfortable with data — CSVs, spreadsheets, data exports. You do not need to be an analyst, but you need to be comfortable handling structured data.

- Strong written English

- Self-directed — you find problems and propose solutions without being asked

- Honest about AI limitations — you know that LLMs hallucinate, you know AI output needs human review, and you build that review step into everything you do



Strong Advantage (Not Required — But Will Set You Apart):

- Developer background (any language) — even basic scripting, web development, or automation experience is valuable

- Experience building AI prompts, prompt chains, or AI-assisted workflows for business use

- Experience with APIs, no-code tools (Make, Zapier, n8n), or automation platforms

- Experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, or Naver platform

- Experience at a digital marketing agency

- Basic Korean language ability



This role is NOT a good fit if you:

- Use AI only for basic text generation ("write me an
 about X")

- Are not comfortable working with data or spreadsheets

- Prefer to wait for instructions rather than find problems to solve

- Build things without thinking about quality control, review steps, or error handling

- Cannot explain your AI workflow in concrete, specific terms

title: Caller + Social Media Manager

Insurance, Mortgage & Business Lending



**Job Type:** Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term

**Company:** Baz State Insurance, Mortgage & Lending

**Pay:** $450/month base + $50 bonus per closed deal



---



## About Us



Baz State Insurance, Mortgage & Lending is a U.S.-based financial services company in California. We help clients with auto insurance, home insurance, business insurance, home loans, and business funding.



We are growing fast and use GoHighLevel (GHL) as our CRM.



This is a dual role. You must handle both social media and lead calling.



If you only want to do social media, do not apply.

If you do not want to make calls, do not apply.



---



## Part 1 — Social Media



You will manage and create weekly content for our business social media accounts.

* 5 image posts per week

* 3 short videos per week

* Captions with clear calls-to-action

* Post on Instagram,
, TikTok, and LinkedIn

* Canva

* CapCut

* GoHighLevel



---



## Part 2 — Lead Calling



You will call, qualify, and follow up with leads using GoHighLevel.



### Daily Calling Requirement



* Up to 300 calls per day using GoHighLevel power dialer

* Call inbound leads within 5 minutes of form submission

* Follow provided scripts

* Qualify leads for insurance, mortgage, or business loans

* Book appointments

* Confirm appointments

* Log every call, note, and outcome in GHL CRM

* Follow up until the lead is closed or disqualified



This is a high-volume calling role. Do not apply if you are not comfortable making a large number of calls every day.



---



## You Are a Fit If



* You have called U.S.-based customers before

* You are comfortable with high-volume daily calling

* You have managed social media for a real business, not only personal accounts

* Your English is clear, confident, and professional on the phone

* You know Canva, CapCut, and Meta Business Suite basics

* You have used a CRM before

* You are reliable and show up on time every day

* You can follow scripts, systems, and instructions

* You are results-focused, not task-focused



---



## Bonus Points



* GoHighLevel experience

* Insurance, mortgage, real estate, finance, or lending experience

* Appointment-setting experience

* Power dialer experience

* Experience calling U.S.-based leads



---



## What We Measure



| Image posts per week -5 minimum 

| Short videos per week- 3 minimum

| Daily calls - Up to 300/day

| Lead response time - Under 5 minutes 

| Leads contacted - 40%+ of all leads 

| Appointments set - 20%+ of contacted leads

| Appointment show rate - 70%+ 



---



## Compensation



**Base Pay:** $350/month

**Bonus:** $50 per closed deal

**Bonus Cap:** No cap



A closed deal means:



* Bound insurance policy

* Funded mortgage loan

* Funded business loan

* Signed application that results in a funded or bound deal within 30 days



### Example Earnings



* 5 closed deals = $600/month

* 10 closed deals = $850/month

* 15 closed deals = $1,100/month



Salary review after 60 days based on:



* Attendance

* Content quality

* Call volume

* CRM accuracy

* Appointments booked

* Closed deals generated



Higher pay is available only after performance is proven.



---



## To Apply



Complete all steps below. If you miss any step, your application will be ignored.



1. Write **“BAZ STATE READY”** at the top of your message

2. Send your resume

3. Send links to 2–3 business social media accounts you have managed

4. Send a 60-second Loom video or voice message introducing yourself

5. Explain your U.S. calling experience

6. Confirm you can work Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time

7. Confirm you can make up to 300 calls per day



Applications missing any required item will not be reviewed.

Full-time

Monday–Friday

Medical Procedure Sales Consultations

Well groomed, or professional/low key make up for women if you wear make up (not required)

1. Join Google Meeting video calls to conduct consultation with prospective patient

- each consultation has a 30 minute block

-1 hour lunch break during the day

- 2 30 minutes breaks during the day. One in the morning and one in the afternoon



2: Conduct a professional consultation to evaluate the patients hair and provide a transplant quote

-Medical consultations are to be NON SALSEY

--Create connection, make them like you, have them talk themselves into a procedure

--Keep it light and Fun

--Not stiff and rigid like most medical practices are like.

---Create connection, make them like you, have them talk themselves into a procedure

---Keep it light and Fun

---Not stiff and rigid.



--Follow our consultation playbook, but loosely so you can adjust to the conversation

6. Make follow-up calls

--Deposits

--Pay balance in full

--Send financing application information

--Respond to post consultation follow up communications. 



9. Maintain meticulous note

-- The highest performing consultants land most of their completed procedures via diligent and professional follow up

---Most people do not book or pay deposit during consultation

---Most pay deposit and book a procedure post consultation - Sales cycle can be  from 7 up to 90 days long.



REQUIRED SKILLS

1. Fluent English

2. Very little accent / American-sounding phone voice preferred

3. Strong sales skills

4. High energy and positive attitude

5. Reliable and punctual

6. Diligent in note taking

-Gmail

-Slack

EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS:

1. Fast and reliable internet - with backup options available

2. Quiet work environment

3. Good quality headset

4. PC or Laptop computer

5. High resolution resolution webcam



COMPENSATION:

1. Paid training - $150 per week

2. 100% commission after 4 weeks

3. 5% of total procedure price

- Average hair transplant is $5000 so your commission is $250

- Top Consultants close 20-30 procedures per month.

- Expect to close about 5 your first full month (week 5-8) of sales on your own.  And quickly get to 10+ per month soon after that.

4. Payment is only on completed procedures (cancelations do happen occationally)

5. Payment is made for an entire months patients and paid on the 15th of the following month

- Example: all completed June procedures from your consultations paid July 15th



TRAINING

1. 4 weeks of training

2. Familiarize yourself with out training playbook 

3. Familiarize yourself with our best practices and knowledge base.

4. Familiarize yourself about hair restoration

5. Observe and learn the consultation process

BODIED is a fast-growing women's fitness platform based in the United States. We connect female fitness influencers with a done-for-you coaching and program platform — helping creators monetize their audience without the work of building a business from scratch. We are in our launch phase and growing quickly.



About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to research and build a list of potential influencer partners for BODIED on TikTok and Instagram. This is a research and data entry role only — no outreach, no messaging, no sales. Your job is to find the right people and log them accurately in our shared Google Sheet every day.

This is a long-term position with room to grow as the company scales. We treat our team members with respect, pay on time every time, and provide clear instructions so you always know exactly what to do.



What You'll Do Every Day

Search TikTok and Instagram using provided hashtags and search terms to find female fitness and lifestyle creators who match our target profile. Who We're Looking For — ADD These Profiles



Women with 10,000–500,000 followers on TikTok and/or Instagram

Posts fitness, gym, lifestyle, or health and wellness content

Posts consistently — at least 3 to 4 times per week

Has real, genuine engagement — actual comments from real followers, not just emojis or bot activity

Anyone who uses the words "coaching," "my program," "my clients," or "work with me" anywhere in their bio, captions, or highlights

Anyone who posts client results or client transformation content

Anyone who has posted less than 3 times in the past week

Full name or display name

Instagram handle

TikTok handle

Primary platform (Instagram, TikTok, or both)

Approximate follower count

Engagement quality rating — High, Medium, or Low (your honest assessment)

Content niche — for example: gym and lifting, lifestyle, nutrition, bodybuilding, etc.

Profile URL

Date added

Strong attention to detail — accuracy matters more than speed

Able to work independently and meet daily quotas without being micromanaged

Experience with Google Sheets required

4 hours per day, Monday through Friday

title: Company Accountant
description:
We are an Australian automotive and trade services business using Odoo as our ERP. This role suits an accountant who enjoys autonomy and is comfortable owning a finance function independently — managing AP, AR, payroll, inventory, BAS, month-end close, and reporting for the business.



About the Role

This is a full function ownership role. You will be the sole finance resource for the business — managing everything from daily transactional processing through to month-end close, inventory reconciliation, payroll, BAS compliance, and management reporting. You will have direct access to the business operations lead for approvals and escalations.



The right person has done this before, is comfortable working independently, and does not need a team around them to deliver clean, reliable numbers.



Key Responsibilities

• Own the full month-end close in Odoo — journals, accruals, prepayments, depreciation, and balance sheet reconciliations

• Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable — invoice processing, cash application, collections, and supplier reconciliations

• Reconcile bank accounts daily in Odoo, independent of the payments you process

• Perform monthly inventory reconciliation — reconcile the inventory subledger to the GL and investigate all stock variances

• Process payroll for all employees in Rippling — prepare, reconcile, and submit for written approval before any funding

• Prepare BAS workpapers and coordinate with the external accountant for lodgement

• Meet all Australian statutory obligations — PAYG withholding, superannuation, and payroll tax on time

• Prepare monthly P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement with variance commentary for management

• Assist management with weekly cash flow forecasting and working capital monitoring

• Maintain Odoo chart of accounts integrity and document all finance processes as SOPs



What We Are Looking For

• Degree in Accounting or Finance — CPA or equivalent preferred

• Minimum 4 years accounting experience with at least 2 years owning a finance function end-to-end

• Strong, hands-on Odoo experience across finance modules — able to work independently without system support

• Experience in a business holding physical inventory — essential

• Experience with inventory reconciliation and stock management in Odoo or a comparable ERP — essential

• Solid knowledge of Australian GST, BAS, PAYG withholding, and payroll tax obligations

• Experience with Rippling payroll or an equivalent cloud payroll platform

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets — reconciliation workpapers and financial reporting

• Strong written English — able to report clearly to Australian management

• Self-directed and reliable — genuinely comfortable as the sole finance resource



What We Offer

• Full ownership of a finance function — genuine responsibility, not a support role

• Stable, long-term contractor engagement

• Direct access to the business operations lead and group CFO

• A small, focused business where your work makes an immediate and visible difference



This is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of a finance function and work directly with business leaders in a growing Australian trade services business.



Mandatory Screening Questions

Answer all questions in your application. Applications without answers will not be reviewed.



Screening Question Required

How many years of hands-on Odoo experience do you have? 3+ years

Have you owned a month-end close process end-to-end without supervision? Yes

Have you worked in a business that holds physical inventory? Yes

Have you performed inventory reconciliation in Odoo or a similar ERP? Yes

Have you prepared Australian BAS workpapers for external lodgement? Yes

Have you processed payroll using Rippling or a similar cloud payroll system? Yes

Are you comfortable as the sole finance resource for a business? Yes

Do you hold an accounting degree or equivalent qualification? Yes



To apply: submit your CV and answers to all eight screening questions. Shortlisted candidates will receive a full position description prior to interview. 



Remuneration dependent on experience and qualification.

title: Fitness App Beta Tester – Provide Screenshots & Detailed Feedbac
description:
Project Overview

We are developing a premium fitness progress tracking app focused on body transformation, privacy, and motivation. The app helps users securely track their fitness journey with powerful tools like Before/After comparisons, AI-powered morphs, privacy censors, Future Me predictions, and secure galleries.

We need realistic beta testers to use the app naturally, capture high-quality screenshots of key features, and provide honest, constructive feedback.



Main Deliverables

1 Scan once or twice a week, 30-60 minute testing sessions a couple times a week or so (depends on changes made to app, that need testing)



You will test the app and submit:



High-quality screenshots (at least 8–12 staged compositions) showing real use of the core features.

Detailed written feedback on usability, design, motivation, privacy feel, bugs, and suggestions for improvement.



Each time you test the app, you will be Required to take several Screenshots, and answer some questions about each page of the app. 



Before vs After slider (with comparison photos) Ranking on how hard, easy features were to find and understand, 

AI Face Blur in action

Body Censor / Privacy protection for progress photos

Morph / Transformation timeline animation

Future Me visualization (current vs predicted physique)

Secure / Locked private gallery

Progress Tracking Dashboard (weight, measurements, timeline)

Daily Check-in / Logging screen



You may also include additional screenshots of other flows you discover.

Testing Tasks & Flow

Use the app as a real user would:



Take realistic progress photos (mirror selfies, front/side views). You can simulate “before” (relaxed) and “after” (flexed/toned) looks.

Test Before/After Comparison tool.

Test Morph / Transformation feature.

Test AI Censoring (body privacy) and Face Blur – demonstrate privacy features

Test Future Me prediction.

Test Progress Tracking (logging weight, measurements, photos).

Test Private & Secure Storage (PIN/password setup and locked gallery).

Explore the full app and note anything that feels motivating, confusing, premium, or clunky.



Pays 5 an hour, and will have 1-2 hours a week, Can be done in evenings or whenever.

title: Senior WordPress Developer
description:
Responsibilities as our Senior WordPress Developer



The Senior WordPress Developer will take ownership of support-related development tasks and help Wolf IQ maintain and improve the customer-facing side of our WordPress ecosystem.

This role is critical in enabling our customers to continue to receive high-quality, timely support and technical improvements.



- Own and resolve complex WordPress and Web Hosting related support tickets

- Implement front-end and back-end improvements across our WordPress-based platforms

- Work with custom themes, page builders, and plugins to enhance performance and usability

- Support ongoing styling and customization efforts (e.g., iframe styling, consistent headers)

- Collaborate with the internal team to implement and maintain tools like the feedback system and reputation platform

- Contribute to the scalability of internal tools and future customer-facing dashboards (e.g., tagging systems for ticket management)



Qualifications



- 5+ years of hands-on WordPress development experience

- Strong understanding of both front-end (HTML, CSS, JS) and back-end (PHP, MySQL) development

- Familiarity with major page builders (Breakdance, Elementor, WPBakery, etc.)

- Understanding of DevOps or willingness to learn (e.g., deployment workflows, environments)

Experience with Support or CRM Tools:



- Familiarity with tools like Help Scout and HubSpot is a big plus. At Wolf IQ, we’re building and integrating internal tools to manage support tickets, customer communications, and review automation—experience working with or developing for these types of systems will help you hit the ground running.

 - If you’ve helped build internal dashboards, admin panels, or workflow tools, especially within WordPress or using modern JS frameworks (e.g., React), we’d love to hear about it. You'll occasionally collaborate with our internal tools team on projects like the Feedback Tool, Reputation Management Tool, or the upcoming Wolf IQ Hub.



API Integration Experience:

- Bonus if you’ve worked with external APIs (e.g., Google Reviews API, CRM APIs, or payment gateways) to enhance WordPress functionality or automate processes.

- 



We are looking for a strong YouTube automation editor who understands storytelling, retention, visual pacing, and how to use AI tools like HeyGen to create a more polished viewing experience.



This is not a basic faceless-channel role where you simply place random stock footage over a voiceover. We need someone who can take a long-form script and turn it into a clean, engaging, documentary-style YouTube video that feels intentional, not rushed or generic.



The editing style may look simple on the surface, but the taste required is high. You should know how to use archival photos, cinematic b-roll, subtle motion, sound design, and AI host/avatar 
nts to keep viewers engaged for 30–40 minutes.

 • Edit long-form YouTube automation videos using voiceover, visuals, music, sound effects, subtitles, b-roll, and pacing designed for retention.

 • Use HeyGen or similar AI avatar tools to create host segments, CTAs, intros, transitions, or other human-feeling 
nts.

 • Source strong historical images, clips, and b-roll that match the script, time period, culture, and story.

 • Improve slower sections with better visuals, pacing, sound design, or avatar/host 
nts.

 • Create high-quality clickable thumbnails using ChatGPT and other AI/design tools.



Position Details:

 • Schedule: Monday to Saturday, flexible hours.

 • Salary: $400 USD per month + cash bonuses for videos that reach 100k+ views.

 • Long-term role with potential for increased pay as the channel network grows.



Requirements:

 • Experience editing traditional YouTube automation videos.

 • Experience using HeyGen or similar AI avatar tools.

 • Understanding of long-form retention for 20+ minute videos.

 • Strong visual taste and ability to avoid cheap/generic stock footage.

 • Ability to edit for a mature, curious audience rather than using loud, childish editing.

 • Reliable, communicative, and able to work independently.



Ideal Candidate:

 • You have edited documentary-style, history, food, culture, video essay, or educational YouTube content before.

 • You understand YouTube automation workflows and can work efficiently.

 • You are comfortable using AI tools in the production process.

 • You have a good eye for historical accuracy, visual consistency, and emotional tone.

 • You know how to use Ken Burns movement, film grain overlays, clean typography, b-roll, archival images, and subtle transitions tastefully.



How to Apply:

 1. Start your application with your favorite animal.

- Has their own laptop or desktop computer with a stable internet connection.

- Has their own video editing software (CapCut works great).

- Can follow instructions carefully without needing to be told the same thing twice.

description:

title: Video Editor for Meta Ads (eCommerce)  ($800 - $1500 USD/mo)
description:
Most video editing jobs on this platform will ask you to edit a lot of videos, fast.



We're the opposite. We want you to edit fewer videos, better.



Our D2C brands spend real money on Meta ads (millions of impressions every month) and every cut you make gets tested against hard performance data. Hook rate, thumbstop, CTR, ROAS. The work is judged by whether it actually moves numbers, not whether it looked cool in review.



That means two things for you:

1) You'll get obsessive levels of feedback. A reviewer will tell you how to improve every video, every time. This happens constantly. If that sounds like hell, leave now. If it sounds like the best editing job you've ever had, keep reading.



2) You'll actually get good. Really good. Editors who stay with us for a year become the kind of editors who can't go back to generic freelance work because they've seen what performance-driven iteration does to their skills. 



We have tea
mbers who've been here 2+ years and they run things now.



What we pay: 

- $
/month based on experience

- Paid vacation time 

- Paid PH holidays off (all of them!)  

- Weekends off 

 

Here's the honest part: 

You'll get a lot of feedback. Sometimes on cuts you thought were finished. The bar is high because our ads are seen by millions of people.



This isn't a side gig. Our work needs your focus, and if you're stitching this together with two other clients, we'll see it in the quality and we'll part ways fast. If you want a real seat at a real company, that's what we're offering.



What we want: 

- Editors who've edited paid Meta ads for eCommerce. Not YouTube content, not weddings, not corporate explainers

- We're also building AI-generated video into our pipeline in ways most brands haven't figured out. You'll learn and shape how we use it.



Career path

- If you want to lead: you can be managing your own team within 12 months as a strong performer. We promote from the inside.

- If you don't want to lead: you'll have a rare kind of job security. AI isn't replacing our senior editors. Our senior editors run AI. The more the tools evolve, the more valuable you become.



How to apply: 



Takes about 20 minutes if you do it properly. We read every answer. Rushed applications get rejected first.



The process: You fill out Form ? We review your portfolio ? Interview ? Paid trial ? Job Offer.

title: Senior Residential Appraisal Report Writer
description:
I run a residential appraisal firm located in the Bay Area, California, and am looking for an experienced residential appraisal writer to join the team. The team includes 3 Bay Area appraisers and 8 employees in the Philippines. We are rapidly growing and are looking for an experienced and senior level residential report writer to join our team.



Your role will be to do the following:

1. Complete the entire residential appraisal report after the appraiser has provided you with the inspection information and comparables. This includes all the commentary, adjustments, and all other parts of the report. We will provide training on how we specifically expect the commentary and adjustments based on our own personal preferences, however you are expected to already have this type of experience working for other appraisers.

2. Review the work of other report writers on our team, provide feedback, and help train newer report writers on our team. You are expected to act as the "last line of defense" of the report before it is sent to the appraiser for their final review before submission. As such, we expect you to be able to review the report, find any issues, correct these issues, and then send to the appraiser a near perfect report.



To be considered for this role, you must meet the following criteria:

1. You have worked for a US residential appraiser

2. You have experience performing data entry for residential properties in the US

3. You have experience creating the 1004MC, selecting comparables, drawing the sketch, labeling photos, making adjustments to the sales grid, and making commentary for the addendum.

4. Ideally, you have experience managing other appraisal report writers.



If you don't have experience in writing commentary or the addendum, or do not have experience with making adjustments on the sales grid, we would still like to hear from you as we have a different job that would fit your experience better.



We are flexible with your work hours and offer Philippine daytime shift hours for your convenience. We would like to start part time but then transition to full time, so ideally you are open to working full time exclusively with us if its a mutual fit.



To be considered for this position, you must do the following in your application message (failure to do all of the following will result in your application being ignored):

1. How many years have you worked for a US residential appraiser? What tasks did you perform for them?

2. How many hours does it take you to complete one report? What parts of the report do you complete?

3. Do you have experience writing commentary for the addendum, drawing the sketch, labeling photos, and creating the 1004MC? Please indicate which ones you have experience with, and how many years for each.

4. Please provide a sample of at least one appraisal report you have fully completed. You can redact any private information from the report. Please let me know what parts exactly you completed on this report(s).

5. Provide a publicly accessible link to your resume.

6. Are you open to starting part time and then transitioning to full time? Once working full time with us, will you be working exclusively with us without any other jobs? When is the earliest you can begin working with us?

7. What are your preferred working hours?

8. Do you have experience managing other residential appraisal report writers? If so, please discuss in detail your job responsibilities.



Thank you, and I look forward to the opportunity to work together.
